info.longName: Dimensional Global Sustainability Fixed Income ETF

funds_data.description: The fund invests in a broad portfolio of investment grade debt securities (e.g., rated AAA to BBB- by S&P or Fitch or Aaa to Baa3 by Moody’s of U.S. and non-U.S. corporate and government issuers, including mortgage-backed securities, while excluding or underweighting securities of corporate and certain non-sovereign government issuers based upon the Portfolio’s sustainability impact considerations.
